lock.parent: Umzali uvula le phrofayela, ngephasiwedi noma ngokhiye wokungena wakhe.
lock.cantText: Ngaphandle kokhiye wakho wokungena, iphasiwedi noma ikhodi yokubuyisa, akekho ongavula okugcinwe lapha. Kuhlala lapha uma kungenzeka kutholakale okukodwa; enye iphrofayela ingakususa.
lock.afreshText: Akukho kule divayisi okusakuvula. Ukuqala phansi kuyakususa; ungabe usubuyisela isipele noma ifolda yakho evumelanisiwe.
lock.afreshConfirm: Susa iphrofayela “{name}” nakho konke okugcinwe kuyo, unomphela?
lock.codeForm: Amaqembu ayisishiyagalombili wezinhlamvu ezine, 0 kuya ku-9 no-A kuya ku-F, nedeshi phakathi kwamaqembu.
lock.noPasskey: Akukho khiye wokungena okwazile ukukukhiya lapha. Sebenzisa iphasiwedi esikhundleni salokho.
lock.sealed: Konke okugcinwe lapha kubethelwe kule divayisi. Kukhiye, ukuze kuvulwe nguwe kuphela.
lock.withPasskey: Kukhiywe ngokhiye wakho wokungena. Kuvuleka kuphela ngawo noma ngekhodi yakho yokubuyisa.
lock.withPassword: Kukhiywe ngephasiwedi yakho. Kuvuleka kuphela ngayo noma ngekhodi yakho yokubuyisa.
lock.synced: Ifolda yakho evumelanisiwe igcina amakhophi angakhiyiwe.
lock.code: Ikhodi yakho yokubuyisa iyakuvula uma ulahlekelwa ukhiye wakho wokungena noma ukhohlwa iphasiwedi yakho. Ngaphandle kwakho, akekho ongavula okugcinwe lapha. Yigcine endaweni ephephile.
lock.opens.anyone: Noma ubani osebenzisa le divayisi angakuvula
